# Cycling the longer flat route

The canal route adds a mile but avoids the junction where I hold my breath. My fitness tracker calls it slower progress. I arrive less shaken and ride more often. Keep both routes rather than searching for a single optimal one. [[Routes]] could include what a journey leaves me able to do afterwards, not just its length and moving time.
